method: breaths by loudness (under -15 dB for 0.5 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 13 of 20 breaks heard

lines.english: Let the hosts of heaven celebrate thee, Joseph;
let all the choirs of Christians resound with thy praise,

lines.latin: Qui clarus méritis, junctus es ínclytæ
lines.english: who, glorious in merit, wast joined
in chaste wedlock to the renowned Virgin.
When thy spouse was great with the holy Child,
marvelling, thou art troubled with anxious doubt;
by the breath of the Spirit from on high, an Angel
teacheth that the Child was conceived.

lines.latin: Tu natum Dóminum stringis, ad éxteras
lines.english: Thou embracest the new-born Lord; to the far lands
of Egypt thou followest Him, a fugitive;
lost in Jerusalem, thou seekest Him, and findest Him,
mingling joys with tears.

lines.latin: Post mortem réliquos sors pia cónsecrat,
lines.english: Others a holy lot doth consecrate after death,
and glory receives them when they have won the palm;

lines.latin: Tu vivens, Súperis par, frúeris Deo,
lines.english: thou, while living, like to the Saints above, enjoyest God,
more blessed by a wondrous lot.
Spare us who pray to Thee, O Trinity most high;
grant us by the merits of Joseph to climb to the stars,

lines.latin: Ut tandem líceat nos tibi pérpetim
lines.english: that at length it may be given us for ever
to pour forth to Thee a pleasing song.
Amen.
